notes: A heavy level lintel over a dark recess with one narrow iris slit in a black socket; the slit's ends dip and the iris is a low dome resting on the lower lid, watching the ground in front. Anchor = the neck point (bottom centre). idle: the eye watches: a short heavy blink, open, a slow glance left, back. flare: the slit fills and blazes (telegraph before an attack). roar: dip with the eye squinted, lift 2/3/3/3 with a 1 px rumble as it snaps open, settle; the lintel lifts one more pixel at the peak so the slit opens taller. The lift is baked into the frames (peak 3 px), so the body's dark neck notch shows under the head.
